definition: A specific form of data contamination where synthetic training data inadvertently incorporates content derived from benchmark test sets.
details: This is an increasingly relevant concern as more training data is itself generated by other LLMs, which may have been influenced by exposure to benchmark content during their own training or generation process.
story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. Here is the short version: A specific form of data contamination where synthetic training data inadvertently incorporates content derived from benchmark test sets. The part that makes it sing: This is an increasingly relevant concern as more training data is itself generated by other LLMs, which may have been influenced by exposure to benchmark content during their own training or generation process. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. And that, done honestly, is Synthetic Benchmark Contamination.
